paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的宁对字符颜色组三条分别选有、没有、不确定；乔选有、不确定、没有。两份计数完全相同，各一条有、没有、不确定、零条跳过，但对跨场合相似与只想到符号时的回忆不同。计数不能替代逐条回看，更不能证明谁的联想更稳定。这里没有让人反复选色，回忆到相似不等于实验测得一致。

title.en: A useful observation without a label

Participants may disagree, decline or stop, without supplying their own colour associations, sounds, bodily locations, diagnoses or anyone else’s experiences. Discussion is no sensory demonstration or credibility contest.

Every prompt requires an explicit recollection, relevant opportunity without recollection, unsure or no opportunity / decline. Blank is unfinished. The fourth choice combines no relevant opportunity with a preference not to answer; the page cannot separate those reasons. Unsure is no half-yes. Four literal counts sum to three in each group, with every original prompt and choice retained. There is no cross-group total, mean, percentage, dominant type, threshold, strength or personal probability. All no, all unsure or all skip still display the same five general guides. A no response concerns recall in the requested window, not lifetime absence. Three months is an editorial choice, not a confirmation criterion. Items, grouping and language equivalence remain unvalidated. Research background supplies no experimental validity for these new prompts. Repeating them tests neither automaticity, consistency nor change, and infers no intelligence, empathy, creativity, hearing or health. No induction, sound stimulus, food, touch, observation video, recording, bodily map or private sensory example is required. Reading alone or leaving is allowed. New, distressing or disruptive experiences warrant advice about actual circumstances without using counts to establish a cause. Responses and counts stay in current page memory, with existing clearing on refresh, language change, leaving, history restoration, clearing or retaking; there is no draft or account history. Copying includes all five public guide titles and links without personal choices or counts. Ordinary page analytics is disabled; optional anonymous action counts require page permission and site analytics consent. Clearing erases no browser history, screenshots or screen observation. Public reading and discussion require no proof of a sensory identity.

paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Fictional Yue recalls a letter seeming serious but is unsure about recurrence and ordinary counting; Cheng has deliberately invented number characters and is unsure about the relevant descriptions. Personality-like wording supplies no MBTI or career conclusion.

title.en: The record keeps the distinctions visible

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的洛在词语味道条选有，观察触碰条选没有，词语触觉条选跳过；岚在第一条选跳过、第二条选有、第三条选没有。都是一条有、一条没有、一条跳过，却涉及不同现象，不能合成一种味觉触觉能力。“跳过”还合并了没有机会与不愿回答，网页没有区分原因，讨论者不能替人物补全。肯定观察触碰也不证明知道被触碰者的感受。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Fictional Lo selects yes for word-related taste, no for observed touch and skip for word-related touch; Lan selects skip, yes and no respectively. Both have one yes, one no and one skip concerning different phenomena, yielding no combined taste-touch ability. Skip also combines no opportunity and declining; the page distinguishes no reason, and discussants cannot fill it in. Endorsing observed-touch experience establishes no knowledge of the touched person’s feelings.

title.en: A short editorial map, used privately
title.zh: 私人使用的简短编辑地图

paragraphs.zh: 本版本仅供18岁及以上成年人回顾近三个月普通场合。十五条按五个编辑类别连续各三条组织，不是五个验证因子；词语、味道与触觉组尤其保留不同现象。每条必须明确选择记得有过、有机会却未记得、不确定或无机会／不愿回答，空白尚未完成。第四项不能进一步区分无机会与不愿回答，不确定也不是半条有。每组四种字面计数相加为三，并保留全部原题与选择；没有跨组总分、均分、百分比、主导类型、阈值、强度或个人概率。全没有、全不确定或全跳过也显示五份相同通用指南。没有只针对指定时段的回忆，不证明终身缺失。三个月是编辑选择，不是联觉确认标准；题目、类别与中英文等值尚未验证。研究背景不替新题提供实验效度，重复作答不测自动性、一致性或变化，也不能推断智力、共情、创造力、听力或健康。无需制造体验、声音刺激、食物、触碰、观察视频、录音、身体图或私人感官例子。可以只读或离开；新出现、困扰或干扰日常的体验按实际情境寻求适当意见，不靠计数确定原因。回答与计数仅留在当前页内存，刷新、换语言、离开、历史恢复、清空或重测按现有流程清除，无草稿或账户历史。复制仅含全部五篇公开指南标题与链接，不含个人选择或计数；常规页面分析关闭，可选匿名动作计数需本页许可和全站分析同意。清除不会抹掉浏览器历史、截屏或旁人看屏；公开阅读与讨论都不要求证明某种感官身份。
paragraphs.en: This edition is for adults aged 18 and over recalling ordinary occasions in the past three months. Fifteen prompts form five consecutive editorial groups of three, not five validated factors. The word, taste and touch group particularly retains different phenomena. Every prompt requires an explicit recollection, relevant opportunity without recollection, unsure or no opportunity / decline. Blank is unfinished. The fourth choice combines no relevant opportunity with a preference not to answer; the page cannot separate those reasons. Unsure is no half-yes. Four literal counts sum to three in each group, with every original prompt and choice retained. There is no cross-group total, mean, percentage, dominant type, threshold, strength or personal probability. All no, all unsure or all skip still display the same five general guides. A no response concerns recall in the requested window, not lifetime absence. Three months is an editorial choice, not a confirmation criterion. Items, grouping and language equivalence remain unvalidated. Research background supplies no experimental validity for these new prompts. Repeating them tests neither automaticity, consistency nor change, and infers no intelligence, empathy, creativity, hearing or health. No induction, sound stimulus, food, touch, observation video, recording, bodily map or private sensory example is required. Reading alone or leaving is allowed. New, distressing or disruptive experiences warrant advice about actual circumstances without using counts to establish a cause. Responses and counts stay in current page memory, with existing clearing on refresh, language change, leaving, history restoration, clearing or retaking; there is no draft or account history. Copying includes all five public guide titles and links without personal choices or counts. Ordinary page analytics is disabled; optional anonymous action counts require page permission and site analytics consent. Clearing erases no browser history, screenshots or screen observation. Public reading and discussion require no proof of a sensory identity.
